metadata.description: InferSports skills — live Asian-priced football & basketball odds and scores, over a read-only keyless REST API.

plugins.name: infersports
plugins.description: Live football & basketball odds + scores: who's favored, the live score, today's matches and a specific day's schedule (timezone-aware), highlights, a one-line pre-match brief, one normalized sharp line, the sharp de-vigged fair probability, whether a Polymarket/Kalshi price is good, today's value spots, odds-format conversion, and finished-match results. Read-only, keyless — no account or API key.
